question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**carry**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the primary function of blood vessels within the circulatory system.
 
• The appropriate verb should convey the movement of blood within the body.
 
• "**Carry**" fits well as it describes the act of transporting blood within the circulatory system.
 
• Other options ("**give**", "**clean**", "**catch**") do not fit the context of describing how blood is moved throughout the system.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One of the **most **__efficient systems of the human body is the circulatory system. It is considered to be made up of complex and delicate blood vessels which __**carry **__blood to and from the heart. This system comprises arteries, veins and capillaries. The blood is pushed out of the heart to arteries (3) ........ high pressure. (4) ........, the arteries have thick and muscular veins. Veins bring blood from all parts of the body and work as the purifying (5) ........ in the system. Capillaries transfer blood from arteries to veins.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Give (देना): "Give" means to hand over or provide, which does not fit the context of describing blood movement in the system.
 
• Clean (साफ करना): "Clean" means to make something free of dirt or impurities, which does not align with the function of blood vessels.
 
• Catch (पकड़ना): "Catch" means to capture or seize, which is not suitable for describing the movement of blood.
